title: Inertial parameterized Douglas-Rachford for generalized DC programming problems
summary: We propose two new Douglas-Rachford type algorithms for solving generalized DC programming problems. More precisely, we deal with the minimization of the sum of two possibly nonsmooth convex functions from which a Fréchet differentiable convex function with a Lipschitz continuous gradient is subtracted, in a Hilbertian framework. We introduce an inertial Douglas-Rachford DC algorithm and a parametrized inertial Douglas-Rachford DC algorithm for solving optimization problems of this type, and study their convergence behavior.
